subject: Infra boundary confirmation for third-party assessment
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <security@finedge.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Question — scope for FinEdge external pen test

Diego / Karthik,

We’re preparing the engagement plan for FinEdge’s external penetration test and need a clear, written boundary for what Redwood-managed systems are permitted for testing versus what will be excluded. Specifically, the customer wants to know whether the following are in-scope:

- Redwood Hosted API endpoints (public API + shared control plane)
- Redwood Dedicated instances (customer-dedicated GPU pools)
- Redwood Private / VPC deployments (customer-managed VPC or on-prem)

Can you confirm which of the above we may test for this engagement and provide any IP ranges, hostnames, or test constraints we should respect?

Also let us know required approval artifacts (signed PoA, allowed test windows, emergency contact). We’ll include these in our statement of work.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Security Lead | FinEdge
security@finedge.com

---
Attachment: none

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <security@finedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question — scope for FinEdge external pen test

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. Below is an operationally accurate boundary we propose for the engagement. Please review and confirm so we can finalize the PoA.

Summary (proposed):
- In-scope: FinEdge Dedicated instances (reserved capacity) assigned to the account, including public ingress endpoints that sit in the dedicated tenant network and any application ports tied to the customer-dedicated serving runtime. We will provide a list of hostnames/IP ranges for the dedicated pool once the booking is finalized.
- In-scope (conditional): Private/VPC deployments that FinEdge owns and manages (on-prem or customer VPC). FinEdge must provide the network ranges and credentials/materials required for authenticated tests inside the VPC. Redwood personnel must not be the target of any account-level destructive activities.
- Out-of-scope: Redwood Hosted public control plane and any shared multitenant services (control plane APIs, shared datastore, and other tenants’ workloads). The hosted control plane is a managed control surface that Redwood does not permit third-party testing against for tenant isolation and regulatory reasons.

Operational constraints / test controls:
- We require a signed PoA authorizing the test and listing the agreed hostnames/IPs; please sign and return the PoA (I’ve attached an environment_inventory.xlsx template for you to populate).
- Test window requests should be proposed at least 7 business days in advance.
- For Dedicated tests, limit blast radius to the provided dedicated instance IDs and do not attempt cross-tenant lateral movement.
- Do not attempt to access Redwood internal administrative consoles, cloud provider control planes, or telemetry/monitoring backends. Those are explicitly off-limits.

Next steps:
1) FinEdge populates and returns the environment inventory (see attachment).
2) We’ll generate an ownership matrix and return the signed PoA.
3) Agree on test dates and emergency contacts.

I’m looping Karthik for confirmation on responsibilities and to add any contractual controls we need in the PoA.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Security Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

---
Attachments: environment_inventory.xlsx (template)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <security@finedge.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question — scope for FinEdge external pen test

Alex — quick follow-up from an ownership/controls perspective. Thanks Diego for the draft boundary. A couple of clarifications we need FinEdge to confirm before we sign off: 

Responsibilities (Redwood vs FinEdge) — please acknowledge:
- Redwood-owned (always out-of-scope): control plane management endpoints, Redwood shared logging/telemetry clusters, cloud provider management consoles, and any hosts not explicitly listed in the environment inventory.
- Customer-owned / delegated (may be in-scope if listed): customer VPCs, on-prem hardware, and connectors that are owned/configured by FinEdge. If these are in-scope, FinEdge must supply network diagrams and point-of-contact for network admins.

Allowed test vectors (examples):
- External reconnaissance and public endpoint scanning of dedicated hostnames/IPs
- Authenticated application-level testing against dedicated instances (we’ll provide test credentials where applicable)
- Controlled exploitation attempts on designated test VMs within the dedicated pool

Disallowed activities:
- Any test that could impact other tenants (no cross-tenant scans or lateral movement attempts)
- Denial-of-service style tests against production shared surfaces
- Accessing Redwood internal consoles or cloud provider APIs tied to account management

Please confirm by replying to this thread and attach the signed inventory/PoA. I’ve attached a short ownership_matrix.pdf for your convenience — populate and return with signatures. 

For emergency contact during the window, we will provide an on-call mobile number and Slack channel; FinEdge should provide their emergency contact as well.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Security | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

---
Attachments: ownership_matrix.pdf

From: Alex Morgan <security@finedge.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Question — scope for FinEdge external pen test

Diego / Karthik — thanks, that all looks good. To confirm FinEdge position: 

- We will test only the Dedicated instances allocated to FinEdge and any FinEdge-owned VPC resources that are explicitly listed in the inventory you provide.
- We will not test Redwood’s Hosted control plane, shared logging, or any infrastructure not listed in the inventory.
- We agree to the disallowed activities you listed (no cross-tenant scans, no cloud console access, no DoS).

Attached is the signed PoA (PoA_signed.pdf) and a populated environment inventory. Proposed test window: 2028-02-02 through 2028-02-04, daily 09:00–17:00 PST. Emergency contact: Alex Morgan (mobile: +1-415-555-0199).

Please confirm you’ve received the signed PoA and that the proposed window is acceptable. Also provide the support Slack channel and on-call number once available. We’d like the final pen report delivered to Jira ticket SEC-9876; I’ll include the ticket link once the engagement starts.

Regards,
Alex Morgan
Security Lead | FinEdge
security@finedge.com
